title: Derived comparisons for the three fixed open direct-image complexes
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let U,V be arbitrary opens, and suppose the derived categories of module sheaves on X,U,V,U intersection V exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let I be a K-injective complex of O_X-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex], let E be in D(O_X), and fix e:Q(I) isomorphic to E. For A=U,V,U intersection V supply any adjunction a_A:D(r_A) left adjoint to Rj_{A*}, with the functors of [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] and [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For the fixed complexes J_A and fixed units eta_A and restrictions rho_{A,W} of [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data], there exist isomorphisms e_A:Q(J_A) -> Rj_{A*}(D(r_A)E) such that Q(eta_U) followed by e_U equals e followed by the a_U-unit at E, and likewise for V; Q(rho_{U,U intersection V}) followed by e_{U intersection V} equals e_U followed by schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction for a_U,a_{U intersection V}, and likewise for V. This statement makes no exactness or cover assertion and imposes no termwise injectivity hypothesis.

source.place: Lemma 20.33.2 (Tag 08BV, lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), displayed direct-image sequence and proof

proof.text: For each A=U,V,U intersection V, kInjective_of_restrict_open shows that the restriction of I to the localized module site is K-injective. Transport along the exact additive Scheme.Modules.overEquiv A: its inverse preserves acyclic complexes, and it transports homotopies, so the tests for K-injectivity are preserved. Apply the inverse of the underived direct-image rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso on r_A(I), followed by the exact-restriction localization comparison and the direct image of restriction of e. This gives canonical e_A.

Derive the fixed underived restriction/direct-image adjunction and identify its left derived functor with the exact restriction functor. The derived unit on QI is Q(eta_A) followed by the direct-image comparison; naturality in e gives the U and V unit identities. The underived rho is the mate of alpha inverse, the restricted counit, and alpha. Under localization and the K-injective comparisons, this formula becomes the mate of the derived counit conjugated by schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso, hence exactly schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction. This gives the two canonical overlap identities.

For each A compare the canonical and supplied adjunctions by the right-adjoint natural isomorphism beta_A compatible with their units. Then eta_supplied=eta_canonical followed by beta_A, and epsilon_supplied=restriction(beta_A inverse) followed by epsilon_canonical. Substitution into the mate formula, naturality of beta for W and of alpha give rho_supplied=beta_A inverse followed by rho_canonical followed by beta_W. Postcompose each canonical e_A with beta_A at the restricted E. These equations give exactly the four displayed identities for the supplied adjunctions.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeOpenModuleImageComplex_comparisons
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (U ⊓ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj I ≅ E)
    (adjU : (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι)
    (adjV : (schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι)
    (adjUV : (schemeOpenRestriction X (U ⊓ V)).mapDerivedCategory ⊣
      schemeDerivedDirectImage (U ⊓ V).ι) :
    ∃ (eU : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X U I) ≅
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj
          ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E))
      (eV : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X V I) ≅
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι).obj
          ((schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory.obj E))
      (eW : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X (U ⊓ V) I) ≅
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage (U ⊓ V).ι).obj
          ((schemeOpenRestriction X (U ⊓ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)),
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexUnit X U I) ≫ eU.hom =
        e.hom ≫ adjU.unit.app E ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexUnit X V I) ≫ eV.hom =
        e.hom ≫ adjV.unit.app E ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction X
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)) I) ≫ eW.hom =
          eU.hom ≫ schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X
            (homOfLE inf_le_left) adjU adjUV E ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction X
        (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)) I) ≫ eW.hom =
          eV.hom ≫ schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X
            (homOfLE inf_le_right) adjV adjUV E
